mapper.insert: INSERT INTO outbox_record (aggregate_type, aggregate_id, event_type, payload, aro_endpoint, summary, status, next_retry_at) VALUES (#{aggregateType}, #{aggregateId}, #{eventType}, #{payload}, #{aroEndpoint}, #{summary}, 'pending', NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM outbox_record WHERE status IN ('pending','failed') AND (next_retry_at IS NULL OR next_retry_at <= NOW()) AND retry_count < 10 ORDER BY created_at ASC LIMIT #{limit} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE outbox_record SET status = #{status}, retry_count = #{retryCount}, next_retry_at = #{nextRetryAt}, last_error = #{lastError}, aro_response = #{aroResponse}, delivered_at = #{deliveredAt} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM outbox_record GROUP BY status
SELECT * FROM outbox_record ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE outbox_record SET aro_url = #{aroUrl} WHERE id = #{id}
